description: The cheapest products currently in stock in a category in one market (Lebanon by default; laptops: cheapest among sensible, new machines first). Optional budget and brand. Up to 10 results.

market.description: Optional market: LB (Lebanon, default), AE (UAE), SA (Saudi Arabia), QA (Qatar), JO (Jordan), OM (Oman), EG (Egypt), KW (Kuwait) or BH (Bahrain). Prices come back in that market's currency.

max_price.description: Upper price limit, in the market's currency.

max_price_usd.description: Upper price limit in USD (converted for non-USD markets).

name: cheapest_in_category
title: Cheapest in a category
